title: Proactive rollback eval sensor for pinned model promotions
creator: Anya Patel
description: Add a lightweight, tenant-aware eval sensor that automatically runs prioritized synthetic probes and quality checks when a model version is pinned or upgraded (catalog or customer-locked). The sensor must surface a concise pass/fail score and, when configured, trigger an automatic rollback or hold if regressions exceed thresholds. Focus is minimizing false positives, controlling eval cost, and integrating with rollout policies and console alerts.
acceptance_criteria: A sensor runs automatically on every catalog model pin and customer tenant pin within configured sampling budgets
Sensor produces a pass/fail score and a short regression summary visible in the Console rollout UI
Configurable thresholds can trigger: advisory alert, canary hold, or automatic rollback (per-project policy)
Cost control: sensor respects per-tenant monthly eval budget and falls back to lower-fidelity probes when budget constrained
Telemetry emitted: probe latency, tokens consumed, drift score, metric deltas, and decision reason
Integration: webhook + Slack + Ops Pager path for P0 regressions and links to the failing prompt examples
tasks: Design eval sensor API and contracts (inputs: model pins, tenant context, sampling policy)
Define default probe suite and fidelity tiers (smoke, fidelity, heavy) with cost estimates
Implement orchestration: sample selection, parallelism limits, and budget-aware downgrade logic
Add sensor decision engine: scoring, hysteresis, and explicit rollback action handler
Console surface: rollout timeline entry with sensor result, top failing prompts, and revert button
Create runbook and escalation playbook for false positives and noisy tenants
End-to-end tests and canary against internal catalog pins before customer-facing rollout
